title: Oven Roasted Italian Lardons Risotto
description: A salty, crisp, and crowd-pleasing Italian dish featuring green curry paste and lardons, perfect for a Mediterranean-inspired meal. This recipe combines the flavors of Italy with the warmth of green curry paste.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Render the lardons in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy.
Add the green curry paste to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the Arborio rice to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook until the liquid is almost completely absorbed.
Add 1 cup of chicken broth to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until the liquid is almost completely absorbed.
Repeat the process of adding chicken broth and cooking until the liquid is almost completely absorbed, until all the broth is used.
Stir in the grana padano cheese and cook until melted and creamy.
Transfer the risotto to a ceramic tagine and top with chopped parsley and crispy lardons.
Bake the risotto in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until lightly browned and crispy on top.
